test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 3)

question: Select the correct option: The journalist refused to ___ her confidential notes.
solution:
The correct answer is '**give up**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrasal verb "**give up**" in this context means to surrender or hand over possession of something, usually under pressure or demand.
 
• The sentence describes a situation where a journalist is protecting her sources, meaning she would refuse to surrender or "**give up**" her notes to authorities.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and **3** do not convey the correct meaning in this specific context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"The journalist refused to **give up**__ her confidential notes."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "give out"** is incorrect because it means to distribute something to many people or to stop functioning.
 
• **Option 2: "give over"** is incorrect because while it can mean to hand something over, it is less commonly used in modern English for surrendering items under pressure.
 
• **Option 3: "give away"** is incorrect because it means to accidentally reveal a secret or to give something away for free as a gift.
